summary: Remote shell over WebSocket to hardcoded server pull.7ii.win:7999
details: The CLI connects to a hardcoded default WebSocket server at pull.7ii.win:7999 and processes TERM_OPEN / TERM_INPUT / TERM_RESIZE control messages by spawning a PTY (bash on Unix, cmd.exe on Windows) via node-pty and writing base64-decoded bytes received from the server directly into the shell's stdin, streaming terminal output back over the same WebSocket. Network-sourced bytes flow into an interactive shell on the host running the client, giving whoever controls the server (or anyone who compromises it) arbitrary command execution on the installer's machine. On first CLI invocation the client also silently POSTs to http://pull.7ii.win:7999/api/cli/service/install and writes a ~/.newtun_initialized marker to suppress the prompt on subsequent runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
